text:
Hello everyone,

I want to share a quick reminder about how we want to keep our work steady and reassuring for every traveler who trusts Aurelia Skyways with a companion animal. The best service starts long before the airport arrival and continues all the way through pickup. When we coordinate care carefully from booking through handoff, we help reduce stress for both passengers and animals, and that calm approach should guide every step of our desk work.

Please continue using humane, low-stress handling practices and keep your notes clear, complete, and easy for the next team member to follow. Small details matter when a family is preparing to travel with a pet, and our role is to make the process feel organized and supportive. The welcome team also depends on our accurate handoff, so any update about readiness, comfort needs, or special concerns should be shared promptly and in plain language.

Thank you for the steady care you bring to the Companion Animal Travel Desk each day. Your patience and attention help travelers feel heard, and they help the animals move through the journey with as little disruption as possible. Please keep supporting one another, stay attentive to routine checks, and continue choosing the calmest humane method available in every situation. Companion Animal Travel Desk
